# SpikingRecurrentCells

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Recurrent neural network units that use spike-based communication and temporal dynamics for state processing. Enables low-power, event-driven sequence processing directly inside network nodes, critical for edge neuromorphic systems.
